info.name: ShopSphere – E-Commerce & Inventory API
info.description: Backend Development capstone (Project 4). Run `npm run seed` first, then run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner or `npm run test:postman`). Each request has assertions covering success, validation-failure, unauthorized, forbidden, not-found, conflict and business-rule cases.

item.name: Update my profile (role field is ignored)
List products (page 1, 6 per page, cheapest first)

exec: pm.test('sorted by price', () => { const p = body.data.map(x => x.price); pm.expect(p).to.eql([...p].sort((a,b)=>a-b)); });

item.description: Checkout, atomic stock, status transitions, access control

exec: pm.test('total computed on server', () => pm.expect(body.data.total).to.eql(Math.round((body.data.subtotal - body.data.discount + body.data.shippingFee)*100)/100));
